name: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
tagline: A strategic genius fights an empire with the power of mind control
description: Exiled prince Lelouch gains the power of Geass, allowing him to command anyone to obey. He leads a rebellion against the Holy Britannian Empire using strategy and manipulation. This mecha thriller features incredible plot twists and one of anime's most iconic endings.
pros: One of the best endings in anime
Perfect blend of mecha and politics
